rhino.name: Rhino River General
rhino.line: Hold the line, secure the fords, and watch our flanks.

orchid.name: Orchid's Patient Ascent
orchid.line: Patience is the root of victory. Let our rivals bleed their ambitions.

kite.name: KITE'S SWEEP
kite.line: Speed wins. Take the east ford early and hold it.

tiger.name: Tiger's River Watch
tiger.line: Hold the middle ground, watch the flanks. Patience is our strongest blade.
